title: Software engineering course project with ChatGPT
summary: Students develop a flexible software engineering course project using their chosen platforms and languages. ChatGPT use was widespread and unconstrained in practice for code generation, algorithms, debugging, defect detection, and other project work.

sources.title: On ChatGPT: Perspectives from Software Engineering Students
sources.evidence_quote: throughout the course project, students have the flexibility to choose platforms and programming languages

context.learner_level: mostly third- and fourth-year computing students

assessment.summary: Develop a software engineering project using student-selected technologies.
student_actions: Design and implement the course project.
Optionally prompt ChatGPT for code and software-engineering assistance.
Assess and modify generated output as needed.

student_role.description: 93.8% of surveyed students used ChatGPT during the project; the source does not report an explicit course policy.
